diaries.name: nse-bse-gap
diaries.rule: When the same stock's price on NSE and BSE differs by more than costs, take the two-sided trade on the stream; unwind as the prices converge.

diaries.name: retail-flow
diaries.rule: Follow the measured retail-flow signal on the stream, sized to 1R, with the stock's own stop.

diaries.name: index-overnight
diaries.rule: Hold the index future overnight when the day's own overnight-return condition fires; flat by the next session's rules. Real overnight cost charged.

diaries.name: dated-events
diaries.rule: Around a stock's own dated events (dividends, splits, and the like), take the position the event's historical drift points to, held for the studied window.

diaries.name: nifty-spreads
diaries.rule: Sell a defined-risk option spread on Nifty / BankNifty when the volatility forecast says the premium is rich; hold to the studied exit. Defined risk, no naked options.

diaries.name: basis-arb
diaries.rule: When a stock's future trades far enough from its cash price to clear costs, take the two-sided basis trade on the stream; unwind as the gap closes.

diaries.name: pairs-mean-revert
diaries.rule: When two stocks that usually move together drift apart by more than their own typical gap, bet the gap narrows; exit when it closes or the stop is hit.

diaries.name: Congressional-trade copying
diaries.rule: Buy a US stock within a week of a US lawmaker disclosing a purchase; hold ~3 months.

diaries.name: Earnings drift (PEAD)
diaries.rule: Buy an F&O stock the day after a positive earnings surprise; hold ~40 days.

diaries.name: News continuation
diaries.rule: Buy a strong positive news move backed by heavy volume; hold a few days on a trailing stop.

diaries.name: News mean reversion
diaries.rule: Fade an extreme one-day move (buy after a sharp drop); cover as it reverts over a few days.

diaries.name: Numerology date rules
diaries.rule: Go long/short the index on numerology-significant calendar dates; close on the next such date.

diaries.name: Opening-range breakout
diaries.rule: Buy when price breaks above the first 15-minute range; exit at the close or a stop below the range.

diaries.name: Option variance-risk-premium selling
diaries.rule: Sell a defined-risk index-option spread when implied vol is above realised; close at expiry or a 2x-credit stop.
